items.title: For a category with chaotic topology and flat restriction maps, quasi-coherent objects of the derived category are exactly the complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the quasi-coherent objects of the derived category with the complexes whose cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent, for a category with chaotic topology whose restriction maps are flat (statement lines 11552-11561). The proof (proof lines 11563-11605) runs the same computation in both directions: for M in QC(O) it evaluates H^i(M)(U) as H^i(R Gamma(V,M)) tensor_{O(V)} O(U) using flatness and the exactness of sections in the chaotic topology, hence the cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent; conversely quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves satisfy the module-level criterion, which turns the cartesianity identity into an isomorphism. H2: one computation applied twice, written out.
